mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(cm.id) FROM chat_message cm JOIN chat_room cr ON cm.room_id = cr.id WHERE (cr.owner_id = #{userId} OR cr.buyer_id = #{userId}) AND cm.sender_id != #{userId} AND ((cr.owner_id = #{userId} AND cm.read_by_owner = false) OR (cr.buyer_id = #{userId} AND cm.read_by_buyer = false))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (room_id, sender_id, content, read_by_owner, read_by_buyer, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{chatRoom.id}, #{senderId}, #{content}, #{readByOwner}, #{readByBuyer}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET room_id = #{chatRoom.id}, sender_id = #{senderId}, content = #{content}, read_by_owner = #{readByOwner}, read_by_buyer = #{readByBuyer}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
